Hi Anna —

Thanks again for the productive call earlier. To ensure the Q4 booking for Netline (DL-8731) hits recognition in November, we need to align on two operational items:

1) PO issuance timing (exact PO number + date) — this determines whether we can invoice before the month-end billing cutoff.
2) Invoice remit and any specific procurement instructions (billing address, tax form, legal reference).

I've attached a short PO timing template to make it quick for your procurement team to confirm the fields we need. Proposed mutual action plan:
- Nov 20: Procurement confirms intent to issue PO and provides target issuance date
- Nov 25: Deadline for PO to land in order to invoice and recognize in November
- Nov 26–27: Redwood to issue invoice if PO present; otherwise move recognition to next period

Could you loop in procurement/legal and confirm whether Nov 25 is achievable from your side? If Netline needs a different cutoff, call that out and we can flag the commit accordingly.

Thanks — appreciate the quick turnaround on this.
